facebookresearch_pytext/pytext/loss/stru.get_cost_function: retrieve a cost function by CostFunctionType enum for use in structured margin loss
facebookresearch_pytext/pytext/loss/stru.create_structured_margin_loss: create a StructuredMarginLoss instance with configurable cost scale and label loss function
